item.title: No. 2: The Accountant Woke Up From His Nap and Carved the Whole Crew Like a Thanksgiving Turkey
item.description: Uncle_Jim turns a lunchtime +$1,284.39 into a record +$10,964.94, beats StankGravy by $4,491.85 and stretches the streak to W5. SlowPonies round-trips $10,668.57 in an afternoon, and XgonGivIt2ya says "Look over your shoulder" from fourth place, down $9,222.31.

item.title: No. 1: Some Guy Named StankGravy Just Walked In and Robbed the Place
